title: Glass Harbor
subtitle: EXAMPLE ONLY · fictional, not campaign canon

fields.label: Atmosphere
fields.value: At low tide the black sand glitters with fragments of blue glass.

fields.label: Features
fields.value: A leaning beacon; an abandoned customs house; rope bridges over tidal pools.

fields.label: Hook
fields.value: Each dawn, a sealed bottle appears on the same empty pier. Today it contains a map of tomorrow's wreck.
